newsitem.title: USA: Global Industrial to record $26 mln charge.
newsitem.headline: Global Industrial to record $26 mln charge.

text.p: Global Industrial Technologies said on Wednesday that it will record a pre-tax charge to earnings of $26.0 million in the third fiscal quarter ended July 31, largely as a result of a write-down of assets.
Global also said the charge was related to its exit from the construction and mining equipment industry, marked by the sale of its Marion Power Shovel Co unit.
Global said it sold Marion to Bucyrus International Inc for $40.1 million.

"Considering these factors, the company expects to report net earnings before the special charge in the range of $2.00 and $2.15 per share for the fiscal year ending October 31, 1997," the company said in a statement.

In addition, the company said its performance for the year is being affected by production disruptions at Ameri-Forge, weaker-than-anticipated demand and the impact of a strong U.S. dollar versus European currencies.
